name: gemma-code
description: Local agentic coding assistant powered by Gemma 4 via Ollama

gemma-code.maxTokens.description: Maximum context tokens (Gemma 4 supports 128K for E2B/E4B, 256K for 26B/31B)

gemma-code.toolConfirmationMode.description: When to prompt for confirmation before running terminal commands or editing files. 'always': always ask. 'ask': ask for destructive operations only. 'never': run without confirmation (use with caution).

gemma-code.maxAgentIterations.description: Maximum number of agentic tool-use iterations per user message before the loop terminates.

enumDescriptions: Show a diff and ask for confirmation before applying any file edit.
Automatically accept and apply all changes without prompting.
Produce a plan before taking action and show diffs for review.
gemma-code.editMode.description: Controls how Gemma Code applies changes. 'ask': show diff and confirm. 'auto' (Accept): apply immediately. 'plan': produce a plan first.

gemma-code.thinkingMode.description: Enable Gemma 4 thinking mode (<|think|>) for chain-of-thought reasoning before tool use and complex responses.

enumDescriptions: Brief, direct instructions optimized for experienced developers.
Step-by-step instructions with technical term definitions for new developers.
gemma-code.promptStyle.description: Controls the verbosity and style of the system prompt sent to the model.

gemma-code.systemPromptBudgetPercent.description: Percentage of the context window reserved for the system prompt (base instructions + tool declarations). Range: 5-30%.

gemma-code.compactionKeepRecent.description: Number of most-recent messages preserved during sliding-window context compaction.

gemma-code.compactionToolResultsKeep.description: Number of most-recent tool results to preserve during compaction (older results are replaced with one-line summaries).

gemma-code.memoryEnabled.description: Enable persistent memory system for cross-session context recall.

gemma-code.embeddingModel.description: Ollama embedding model for semantic memory search. Set to empty string to disable semantic search.

gemma-code.memoryMaxEntries.description: Maximum number of memory entries before automatic pruning.

gemma-code.memoryCorroborationThreshold.description: Number of independent observations required before a semantic memory is treated as a fact. Single-source observations are kept as candidates and only retrieved when no fact-tier match is available. Set to 1 to disable (legacy behavior: every observation is a fact).

gemma-code.ollamaEmbeddingThreshold.description: Minimum cosine similarity for tool-output rows whose embedding came from Ollama (high-quality nomic-embed-text vectors).

gemma-code.heuristicEmbeddingThreshold.description: Minimum cosine similarity for tool-output rows whose embedding came from the deterministic heuristic fallback. Higher than the Ollama-tier threshold because the 128-D heuristic embedder is noisier.

gemma-code.mcpEnabled.description: Enable Model Context Protocol (MCP) support for interoperability with external tools.

gemma-code.mcpServerMode.description: MCP server mode. 'stdio' exposes Gemma Code tools via MCP stdio protocol. 'off' disables.

gemma-code.verificationEnabled.description: Automatically run a verification sub-agent after multiple file edits to check for bugs and test failures.

gemma-code.verificationThreshold.description: Number of file edits in a session before automatic verification triggers.

gemma-code.subAgentMaxIterations.description: Maximum tool-use iterations for sub-agents (verification, research, planning).

gemma-code.autoDetectGpu.description: Auto-detect GPU and VRAM at startup to select optimal model configuration.

gemma-code.gpuTierOverride.description: Override auto-detected GPU tier. Set to null for auto-detection.

gemma-code.permissionOverrides.description: Override default permission tiers for individual tools. Values: 0 = auto-approve, 1 = confirm, 2 = dangerous. Floor: tools whose baseline tier requires confirmation (delete_file, run_terminal, fetch_page, web_search, write_file, edit_file, create_file, MCP tools) cannot be dropped to 0; the override is silently clamped to 1 with a logger warning.

gemma-code.mcpExposedTools.description: Built-in tools exposed to external MCP clients when the Gemma Code MCP server is enabled. Defaults to the read-only subset; broaden cautiously. Confirmation-tier tools still require user approval per call.

gemma-code.otlpEnabled.description: Enable optional OTLP trace export to an external collector (Jaeger, Grafana Tempo). Off by default for offline-first usage.

gemma-code.otlpEndpoint.description: OTLP HTTP endpoint for trace export.

gemma-code.otlpHeaders.description: Comma-separated key=value headers for OTLP export requests (e.g. 'Authorization=Bearer token,X-Custom=value').

gemma-code.secretPathDenyExtra.description: Extra glob-style patterns (relative to workspace root) that should be treated as secret paths and blocked from file/list/grep tools unless `allow_secrets: true` is passed with per-call confirmation.

gemma-code.operationLog.enabled.description: Append one Markdown-friendly line per tool call to <workspace>/.gemma-code/operation-log.md (default off). Records only metadata: tool name, outcome, optional path, session id; never tool inputs. Trade-off: small disk-cost and visibility into past actions vs. privacy of having a persistent audit trail.

enumDescriptions: Never auto-archive (default). Run /memory archive manually when desired.
Take a snapshot of Instructions.md / Memory.md / Context.md when the latest archive is older than 7 days.
Take a snapshot when the latest archive is older than 30 days.
gemma-code.memoryAutoArchive.description: v0.7.0 Phase 2 -- schedule for automatic memory file snapshots into ~/.gemma-code/memory/<workspace-id>/Archive/<YYYY-MM-DD>/. Auto-archive runs silently on session start when due.

gemma-code.contextLimitsPerModel.description: v0.7.0 Phase 3 -- per-model overrides for max context tokens. Keys are model names (e.g. 'gemma4:e4b'), values are objects with optional 'maxTokens' (number) and 'minContextLimit' (number). Falls back to gemma-code.maxTokens when no override applies.

gemma-code.compactionProtectedTools.description: v0.7.0 Phase 3 -- tool names that every compaction strategy (deduplication, purge-errors, compress) must skip. Protects causally-load-bearing or destructive tool calls.

gemma-code.compactionErrorPurgeTurns.description: v0.7.0 Phase 3 -- after this many user-message turns elapse since an errored tool call, its args are purged (the error result message itself is preserved verbatim).

gemma-code.compactionProtectedFilePatter.description: v0.7.0 Phase 3 -- substring patterns; tool calls whose args contain a matching path are exempt from deduplication.

gemma-code.compactExperimentalMessageMod.description: v0.7.0 Phase 3 -- when true, registers the experimental compress_message tool. Less surgical than compress_range and may fragment causally-linked tool sequences.

gemma-code.memoryHnswThreshold.description: v0.7.0 Phase 7 (C32) -- row-count threshold for activating the optional HNSW vector index over memory embeddings. When the entry count exceeds this value AND `hnswlib-node` is loadable, MemoryStore switches from the FTS5-pre-filtered linear scan to the persistent ANN index. Set to 0 to disable HNSW (linear-scan fallback only).

gemma-code.workers.audit.enabled.description: v0.7.0 Phase 7 (C34) -- when true, every time the file-edit threshold trips the audit background worker invokes `gemma-check --json` on the changed files and posts findings as a chat message. Off by default.

gemma-code.workers.testgaps.enabled.description: v0.7.0 Phase 7 (C34) -- when true, every time the file-edit threshold trips the testgaps background worker runs `vitest --coverage --json` on the test files matching the changed source and posts uncovered branches as a chat message. Off by default.

enumDescriptions: Least-Frequently-Used: keeps popular paths longer; one-shot reads age out fast.
Adaptive Replacement Cache: balances recency and frequency without a tuned parameter.
Window-TinyLFU: small recency window plus frequency-gated admission to a main region.
Clock (Second-Chance): approximates LRU at lower bookkeeping cost.
gemma-code.cacheEvictionStrategy.description: Eviction policy for the in-process tool-output cache. All strategies are pure JS (no native modules).

scripts.deps:graph: depcruise --config configs/dependency-cruiser.cjs --output-type dot src | dot -Tsvg > docs/v0.5.0/dep-graph.svg
